window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes were thin for US and world coverage; only verifiable items are included.

stories.headline: Colombian Navy and Air Force stop a go-fast boat with 3.7 tonnes of cocaine 129 nautical miles off Cartagena
stories.body: On October 17 the Navy, backed by the Air Force and working with prosecutors, intercepted a go-fast boat in the Caribbean carrying 3,688 kg of cocaine, a load officials valued at about $170 million. Five suspected traffickers were captured and the vessel was seized; President Abelardo De la Espriella announced the result on X.

stories.headline: Police find 620 kilos of cocaine hidden in a fuel tanker truck in Quindío
stories.body: During an October 17 inspection on the La Paila–Armenia road near La Tebaida, officers found cocaine hydrochloride concealed in a hidden compartment of a tractor-trailer built to haul fuel. The 620 kg load led to one detention; the driver's identity was not released.

stories.headline: Ecuadorian police uncover 113 kilos of cocaine in a car's false floor in Esmeraldas
stories.body: Officers stopped a vehicle in Camarones, Esmeraldas province near the Colombian border, on October 17 and found 116 blocks of cocaine, 113 kg in all, in compartments built into the floor. One person was detained, and police estimated the loss to the owning criminal group at about $258,600.
